recentItems.title: Remarkable decade on Red Sea: Inside China-Egypt Suez Economic and Trade Cooperation Zone
recentItems.description:
At the invitation of Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, Chinese President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to Egypt.

During President Xi's last state visit to Egypt in 2016, he and Egyptian President El-Sisi jointly inaugurated the expansion of the China-Egypt Suez Economic and Trade Cooperation Zone. Over the past decade, the project has become a landmark of cooperation that aligns China's Belt and Road Initiative with Egypt's Vision 2030.

So how has the zone developed? What progress has been made in deepening China-Egypt economic and trade cooperation? Our reporter went to find out. 

CMG Reporters: Li Xueyao, Yan Yaodong, Zhang Zhuoya, Zhang Yu

recentItems.title: Luban Workshops Build Skills and Connections
recentItems.description:
Since 2020, Egypt's two Luban Workshops, established in cooperation with colleges in Tianjin, China, have been providing hands-on tuition to aspiring technical professionals. At one of them, based at Ain Shams University in Cairo, the training covers fields including CNC (Computer Numerical Control) technology and renewable energy, helping prepare the skilled workers Egypt needs for its development.

recentItems.title: SCO at 25: How the organisation became a global player
recentItems.description:
The Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) turns 25 as leaders gather in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, for this year's summit. What began in 2001 with six founding members has grown into a platform bringing together 10 member states and 17 SCO partners. Over the past 25 years, its cooperation has expanded well beyond regional security to include trade, energy, technology, culture and more. How has the SCO evolved? What does it hope to achieve at this year's summit? And what could its growing role mean for the region and beyond? Watch as we take a closer look at the SCO's journey and where it could be heading next.

Djoomart Otorbaev
Former Prime Minister of the Kyrgyz Republic

recentItems.title: The Heat: US-Iran Conflict | Tehran retaliates
recentItems.description:
Iran has retaliated after the US launched an attack over the weekend on Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island in the southern part of the country. Iran responded by launching strikes at US sites in Jordan. This was the first time in a month that the US and Iran had exchanged fire. 

Meanwhile, the crisis continues in Lebanon where more than 4,300 people have been killed since the latest assault by Israel that began in March. #Iran #LarakIsland #USwar #Trump #Israel #Lebanon #UAE 

#Heat Host: Anand Naidoo 

Guests: 
Ali Akbar Dareini is a researcher and writer at the Strategic Studies of Public Policy Journal in Tehran and the author of "Legitimate Deterrence."
Jamal Abdi is President of the National Iranian American Council.  
Habib Battah is an independent journalist and the founder of the Beirut Report.

recentItems.title: On board for Kyrgyzstan and Egypt Ep.1: A new stage of China-Kyrgyzstan relations
recentItems.description:
At the invitation of Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek on Sunday for the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Summit 2026 and a state visit to Kyrgyzstan.
This is President Xi's third state visit to Kyrgyzstan. President Sadyr Japarov welcomed the distinguished old friend with a grand ceremony.
For more than a decade, President Xi has held multiple meetings with Kyrgyz leaders, guiding China-Kyrgyzstan relations toward leapfrog development. During this visit, the two heads of state signed a joint declaration of the People's Republic of China and the Kyrgyz Republic on the high-quality development of the comprehensive strategic partnership for a new era and a bilateral treaty on permanent good-neighborliness, friendship and cooperation, bringing China-Kyrgyzstan relations to a new stage.
